manual_reference: IACHY102 manual, p.13, worked example under 'Calculation of Delta-G1 (at T1=30C) and Delta-G1a (at T1a=50C)'
notes: Two worked points from the same manual example, both driven through the same final checker (Delta-G = -nF*Ecell). The manual's own Ecell-Nernst worked example (0.05M/0.01M, 303K -> 1.079V, p.13) is covered separately by backend/tests/test_exp01_emf.py, since the golden-dataset harness only exercises the plugin's final checker, not step checkers.

examples.notes: n=2, F=96500, E=0.99V -> manual states -191 kJ/mol at T1=30C (printed to 3 sig figs; exact recompute is -191.07)
n=2, F=96500, E=1.020V -> manual states -197 kJ/mol at T1a=50C (printed to 3 sig figs; exact recompute is -196.86)
